subject: Renewal wrap: usage delta settlement, staged payment, and VAT docs
messages:
From: Leah Grant <finance@clearwell.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rios <procurement@clearwell.tech>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Final reconciliation request — invoice + VAT question

Hi Marissa,

Hope you had a good weekend. As we approach the renewal effective 2028-01-31 for ClearWell, our AP team ran the end-of-term reconciliation and we have a couple of items to close before remittance: 

- Usage delta: we see a higher token/embedding usage in Dec that created a $24,310 variance from the projected committed spend.
- VAT / reverse charge: we need confirmation that Redwood will not be charging VAT (reverse-charge applies) and a statement we can attach for local tax.

Can you share the finalized invoice (with line-level usage) and confirm whether Redwood can accept a split payment? Our standard is 50% now, 50% 45 days later for material true-ups tied to product issues. If you prefer a different cadence we can discuss.

I've attached our provisional spreadsheet that your team can reconcile against your records.

Attachments: [attachment: clearwell_provisional_recon.xlsx]

Thanks,
Leah Grant
Finance Manager, ClearWell Health
leah.grant@clearwell.tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Final reconciliation request — invoice + VAT question

Hi Leah —

Thanks for the note and for sending the provisional spreadsheet. We pulled the usage logs and reconciled against your sheet. Please find the items below and attached files.

Summary: 
- Confirmed usage delta: $24,310 (line-level breakdown attached).
- Draft final invoice attached: redwood_final_invoice_DW-4729.pdf
- VAT: Redwood confirms we will not be charging EU VAT on this renewal under the reverse-charge mechanism. I've attached a short statement for your AP team (VAT_reverse_charge_statement.pdf). Please have your tax/legal confirm that is sufficient.

We can accept a staged payment: 50% on approval of the attached invoice and 50% within 45 days. To make this operational: 
1) Please send the signed PO referencing DW-4729 and the invoice number.
2) Confirm billing entity and wire details (we've provided our standard bank instructions on the invoice).
3) Once PO is received we will route the invoice for CFO sign-off and issue a billing acknowledgement.

Attachments: [attachment: clearwell_final_usage_breakdown.xlsx], [attachment: redwood_final_invoice_DW-4729.pdf], [attachment: VAT_reverse_charge_statement.pdf]

Cc'ing Karthik and Monica to align on collection cadence and ledger mapping.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Internal: ClearWell DW-4729 — invoice split & acceptance checklist

Marissa / Monica —

Thanks for pulling the reconciliation together. A few operational items for collections and accounting before we mark this as ready-to-bill: 

- Split invoice handling: we need two invoice records in NetSuite (one for the initial 50% payment and a second AR memo for the remaining 50% with due date +45 days). Please set the AR terms to Net 45 for the second invoice.
- Tax documentation: upload the VAT_reverse_charge_statement.pdf to the customer tax profile (country: UK). Finance will attach it to the first invoice as supporting documentation.
- PO acceptance: we cannot book revenue until we have a signed PO that references DW-4729 and the invoice number. Request Marissa to confirm the exact PO number from ClearWell and ask AP to attach the signed PO to the DocuSign envelope (if they prefer e-sign).
- Bank details: confirm whether ClearWell will wire in GBP or USD so we can use the correct bank routing. If GBP, provide the intermediary bank info.

Action owners: 
- Marissa: confirm PO and request signed copy from Leah; confirm currency.
- Monica: prepare two invoices in NS and set up the second as a memo for 45-day collection.

Once we have a signed PO and currency confirmation I'll approve the invoice issuance.

Karthik
VP, Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Apologies for the delay. We've agreed internally to the staged payment: 50% on receipt of your finalized invoice and our signed PO; 50% 45 days thereafter. 

Attached: signed PO (ClearWell_PO_DW-4729_signed.pdf) and the AP remittance notes. We confirm wires will be sent in GBP. Our tax team reviewed the VAT statement and are satisfied with the reverse-charge note — they will keep the statement on file for audit. 

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelopes/XYZ-DW-4729 (signed PO available in the envelope).

Next steps on our side: 
- We will release the first wire within 5 business days of receiving the invoice PDF.
- Please provide final invoice number and banking intermediary details for GBP.
